Awards & Recognition

With people and products that care

Building Global Connections Through Innovation

HRI has a presence in over 30 countries across South and Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, the UK, and the US, with products thoughtfully tailored to meet the unique needs of each market.

Our brands are available through leading modern trade retailers such as Carrefour and Lulu, and we have established strong partnerships with global players including PZ Cussons, Lisap, and Carin Cosmetics. We also actively participate in major international trade fairs like Beauty World, strengthening our global engagement and reach.

Driven by quality and innovation, HRI continues to expand its global footprint with trusted partnerships worldwide.
